# Name Combiner Online

> A privacy-first, client-side phonetic name blending engine that combines two names or words into harmonious couple nicknames, baby names, merged family surnames, and brand portmanteaux.

## Overview

Name Combiner Online (https://name-combiner.online/) takes two input names and algorithmically generates natural, easy-to-pronounce combinations. Unlike naive text-slicing generators, it analyzes vocalic nuclei, detects phonetic overlaps, inserts bridging vowels when harsh consonant collisions occur, and strips unpronounceable letter clusters.

- **Website**: https://name-combiner.online/
- **Cost**: 100% Free, no account or registration required
- **Privacy**: Runs entirely client-side in the browser; names are never sent to a database or tracked
- **Output**: Ranked list of phonetic blends with instant one-click copying and personal favorites bookmarking

---

## Core Linguistic Algorithm

The generator executes four linguistic passes on any pair of input names:

1. **Syllable & Vocalic Nucleus Splitting**:
   - Identifies vowel centers (a, e, i, o, u, y) and splits names at phonetic boundaries rather than arbitrary character indices.
   - Preserves melodic roots from both words.

2. **Portmanteau & Overlap Detection**:
   - Scans for identical letters or shared phonetic sounds where Name A ends and Name B begins (e.g., *Brad* + *Angelina* → *Brangelina*).
   - Fuses overlapping transitions to eliminate stuttering syllables.

3. **Vocalic Bridging**:
   - Detects clashing consonant junctions (such as plosives or fricatives back-to-back).
   - Automatically bridges the gap with harmonic transition vowels (*-a-*, *-o-*, *-i-*).

4. **Pronounceability Filtering**:
   - Filters out awkward triple vowels and impossible consonant clusters.
   - Capitalizes proper names cleanly and outputs the most euphonic options first.

---

## Primary Use Cases

- **Couple & Ship Names**:
  - URL: https://name-combiner.online/#use-cases
  - Combines two partners' first names for wedding hashtags, anniversary monograms, relationship nicknames, and fictional character fandom pairings.
  - *Example*: Brad + Angelina → Brangelina

- **Mom & Dad Baby Names**:
  - URL: https://name-combiner.online/#use-cases
  - Blends maternal and paternal names into fresh, melodic baby first or middle names that celebrate both families' heritage.
  - *Example*: Liam + Emma → Lemi / Liem

- **Merged Family Surnames (Last Name Combiner)**:
  - URL: https://name-combiner.online/#use-cases
  - Combines two last names upon marriage or civil union as an alternative to hyphenated surnames.
  - *Example*: Miller + Davis → Millis / Daviler

- **Business, Brand, & Product Monikers**:
  - URL: https://name-combiner.online/#use-cases
  - Merges co-founders' names, partner companies, or descriptive keywords into catchphrases, brand names, and brandable domain handles.
  - *Example*: Net + Flicks → Netflix
